newsitem.title: CHINA: Mongolia takes step to formally join WTO - agency.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia takes step to formally join WTO - agency.

text.p: Mongolia has taken another step towards formalising its entry into the WTO with a resolution calling for the revision of its laws to conform with the trade body's standards, the Xinhua news agency said on Sunday.

The Great Hural, or parliament, had passed a resolution asking the government to adopt measures to conform with World Trade Organisation (WTO) requirements and rules, Xinhua said in a report from the Mongolian capital Ulan Bator.
It gave no details of the required legal revisions.
Mongolia won admission to the WTO in July and its membership will come into force when it finalises its own parliamentary ratification procedures.
"Joining the WTO was a resolute and important decision made by the Mongolian government," Xinhua quoted an official of the Ministry of Foreign Relations as telling a local newspaper.

Mongolia's government, dominated by a democratic coalition since the ex-communist party was ousted in June elections, has vowed to push the remote and developing north Asian nation further along the road of economic reform.
